execution: Not run in this lane; independent source review and the root-owned admitted native browser run remain required. Runtime output is ignored test-results/debug-log-controls-acceptance.json.
profile: The existing owned-profile harness creates a disposable profile and removes it after execution; clear is scoped to that run only.
event_source: Runner compares actual scoped debug-event rows before and after natural public-page navigation/click. It does not write to the debug store or inject events. A missing positive event set keeps event-dependent targets unverified.
credentials: The runner mirrors the proven isolated-admin-signin-acceptance.mjs real UI sequence because that script is an executable entrypoint: open Settings Account, navigate the real web login form, read AI_ADMIN_USERNAME/AI_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the aidream env only when the form is ready, submit through the web UI, click extension Sign in, and verify exact account email, admin role, and Sign out in the real Settings UI. No auth storage injection, credential logging, or raw auth error reporting is used.
evidence: Runtime 003 exercised the warm profile: the real detail row expanded and collapsed, and a natural error badge cleared, while detail-only search lacked a usable natural key. This source-only follow-up adds DEBUG_RELOAD_BEFORE_CONTROLS=1: after the same real admin UI login, the owned side panel receives Page.reload, its main-frame loader ID must change, and Settings Account must again display the exact admin identity before natural event generation and the same control checks. Every receipt names warm or post_real_panel_reload; unrun dimensions and service-error remain unverified. The detail-search probe now prefers a displayed JSON key, then a displayed primitive JSON string/number, requiring one occurrence in the actual detail text and absence from every observed message. The private term is typed through trusted input and the original detail row must survive the filter; no term or event payload is written to receipts. Existing warm runtime receipts remain immutable. Runtime 004 independently exercised the post-real-panel-reload branch and remains immutable; this additional branch does not relabel those warm or reload observations. Search reset now carries an explicit exact prior-count assertion in its private result.
limitations: Run 005 did not establish the offline service-error precondition; this diagnostic revision is source-only and requires independent review plus a new root-owned admitted runtime before claiming that dimension.
The read-only /health probe is intentionally silent in the Debug event log on failure. A visible FAIL and actual network failure do not prove a corresponding error row or badge.

If an online 200/OK control, initial offline failure/FAIL, or final offline failure/FAIL is absent, the service-error dimension remains unverified. Restoration of the owned panel network is mandatory after the battery.
T14 detail search remains unverified if naturally displayed JSON supplies no unique key or primitive value absent all observed messages.
T17 error-badge clearing requires a natural positive badge before Clear; the runner does not create one.

service_error_scenario.source_path: Debug Bridges Channel A Send test ping invokes pingHealth, which issues a read-only GET /health from the side-panel target and displays OK or FAIL. The health helper uses silent request errors, so this does not prove an error log row or badge.
service_error_scenario.proof: The runner captures one actual panel-target GET /health with HTTP 200 and visible OK, then applies target-scoped CDP offline conditions and requires the same-URL GET to report Network.loadingFailed with ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED and visible FAIL. It keeps the owned panel offline while the existing natural-event Debug control battery runs on that panel; the public page remains a separate browser target. After the control assertions, it repeats the health ping and requires another same-URL ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED failure plus visible FAIL. The network/cache settings are restored in finally, including when a control fails. No response mock, event insertion, service write, Chat/Pilot, or global network change is used.
service_error_scenario.privacy: The health URL is held only in memory for exact request matching; result fields contain booleans and fixed stage/categories, never URL, response body, credentials, or event text.
service_error_scenario.evidence_scope: Service-error dimension evidence is conditional on an online positive control, a real ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED request failure and visible FAIL before controls, and the same proof after controls. If the final outage probe is absent, all service-error dimension evidence is downgraded to unverified. The silent health helper does not establish an error log row or positive badge; T17 badge-clearing remains independently conditional. If a control stage fails after the initial proven outage, the runtime result is fail with a fixed stage and a controlFailure flag; this does not by itself classify a product root cause. A missing positive control or missing final outage proof remains unverified.

source_peer_correction: The first source review rejected restoration before the controls, which would have tested ordinary connectivity while claiming a service-error dimension. This revision holds CDP offline state across the actual control battery and verifies it afterward before restoring.

runtime_005_diagnosis.unknown: The run 005 receipt lacks request, response, loading-failure, and UI state counts at the failing sample, so it cannot distinguish no request, a failed preflight/other request, a different CDP target, a non-disconnection network error, an unchanged OK label, or a UI timing problem. No product defect or harness root cause is established.
runtime_005_diagnosis.new_fixed_diagnostic: On offline proof failure, the runner records whether CDP offline application and trusted ping click completed, counts of panel requests, matching /health GET/OPTIONS/other requests, responses/2xx/finished/failed/cache-served requests, allowlisted loading-failure categories, plus fixed OK/FAIL/unavailable UI state, ping button count and disabled state. The same safe summary is available if the final outage probe fails. No raw URL, status text, response, payload, event message, or exception enters the receipt.
runtime_005_diagnosis.preserved_oracle: The service-error dimension still requires exact same-URL GET with ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED and visible FAIL before and after actual offline controls; no timeout or assertion was weakened.
